title: Finish value

tests.expr: (x := lit(3), s := Node('mul', [x, x]), value(Node('mul', [s, s])))[-1]

hints: A `const` node has no sources. Its number is not worked out from anything: it is stored on the node.
The `mul` branch already has both numbers in `a` and `b`. Return `a * b`.
explain: A `const` keeps its number in `arg`, so its value is just that field. Every other node gets its number from its sources: `value` asks each source for its number first, then applies the op, here `a * b` for `mul`. That is the whole interpreter from the start steps, moved from lines to nodes.
